entities.name: Old Cordilleran culture
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The old Cordilleran culture, also known as the Cascade phase, is an ancient culture of Native Americans that settled in the Pacific Northwestern region of North America that existed from 8000 or 9000 BC until about 3500 BC.
